# paraphrase of the classical sources named in the authority column, simplified (2026-10-18).

column2: Mishnah Shabbat 1:1, with the reason of Exod 23:12 (paraphrase)
column3: On the Sabbath a person must not carry a thing in the street, because the Sabbath is a rest.
On the Sabbath a person may carry a thing in a courtyard.
On the Sabbath a Jew must not ask a gentile to light a fire.
On the Sabbath a Jew must not light a fire.

column2: Mishnah Shevi'it 10:1, with the reason of Deut 15:2 (paraphrase)
column3: A creditor must not demand a debt after the seventh year, because the release has been proclaimed.
A creditor may demand a bond of the court after the seventh year.
During Passover a Jew must not keep chametz in his house.
During Passover a Jew may keep the goods of a gentile in his house.

column2: Mishnah Bava Metzia 5, with the reason of Lev 25:36 (paraphrase)
column3: A man must not take interest, because his brother must live with him.
A partner may take the profit.
